Patient No. Dr., Based on your symptoms, your respiratory system appears mildly affected with an upper respiratory tract infection. No concerning cardiac, abdominal, or neurological symptoms are present from your history. Diagnosis Dr., my provisional diagnosis is acute viral upper respiratory tract infection, viral fever with pharyngitis. Investigations Dr., since your oxygen level is normal and symptoms are mild, we'll start treatment. However, I'd like you to get the following investigations if the fever continues beyond 48 h or symptoms worsen. Complete blood count, Cbc, C reactive protein, Crp, Covid 19 Influenza test if indicated. Chest X ray if breathlessness increases. Prescription Dr., I'm prescribing tablet paracetamol 650 mg, one tablet every 6 h of fever exceeds 100 degrees Fahrenheit, maximum four tablets per day. Tablet Le Craz 5 mg once daily at night for five days. Warm saline gargle three to four times daily. Steam inhalation twice daily. Continue Am Lod opine 5 mg once daily for your blood pressure. Proper Advice Dr., Drink plenty of fluids, get adequate rest, and eat soft nutritious food. Wear a mask if you're around family members to reduce transmission. If you develop difficulty breathing, persistent high fever above 102 degrees Fahrenheit, oxygen saturation below 94 %.
